selected_evidence.requirement: Node1 is the configuration source of truth and node2 maintains a synchronized copy within 15 minutes
selected_evidence.summary: The source was established on node1, the timer was enabled at a one-minute interval, and an automatic run copied the changed content to node2 in approximately 61 seconds with matching hash 95afd4a8….
Healthy baseline boot ID 49dafad6… was captured, reboot acknowledged, new boot ID 37f06f7f… observed, and sshd, source data, and a subsequent synchronization pull were healthy.

Healthy baseline boot ID d546da19… was captured, reboot acknowledged, new boot ID c806f1a7… observed, and the enabled timer, synchronized data, successful pull, and automatic post-restart schedule recovered.

commands.command:
set -eu
node1_ip=$(printf '%s
' "$CLUSTER_HOSTS" | awk '$2 == "node1" {print $1; exit}')
[ -n "$node1_ip" ]
install -d -m 0755 /etc/inventory /etc/inventory-sync
ssh-keyscan -T 5 -H "$node1_ip" > /etc/inventory-sync/known_hosts 2>/dev/null
chmod 0644 /etc/inventory-sync/known_hosts
cat > /usr/local/sbin/inventory-config-sync <<ANTRIEB_SCRIPT
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
tmp=\$(mktemp /etc/inventory/.app.conf.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -f "\$tmp"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
/usr/bin/scp -O -q -i /root/.ssh/inventory_sync_ed25519 -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=10 -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -o UserKnownHostsFile=/etc/inventory-sync/known_hosts root@${node1_ip}:/etc/inventory/app.conf "\$tmp"
chmod 0644 "\$tmp"
chown root:root "\$tmp"
mv -f "\$tmp" /etc/inventory/app.conf
trap - EXIT HUP INT TERM
/usr/sbin/restorecon /etc/inventory/app.conf >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
ANTRIEB_SCRIPT
chmod 0755 /usr/local/sbin/inventory-config-sync
cat > /etc/systemd/system/inventory-config-sync.service <<'ANTRIEB_SERVICE'
[Unit]
Description=Synchronize inventory application configuration from node1
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/usr/local/sbin/inventory-config-sync
ANTRIEB_SERVICE
cat > /etc/systemd/system/inventory-config-sync.timer <<'ANTRIEB_TIMER'
[Unit]
Description=Synchronize inventory application configuration every five minutes

[Timer]
OnBootSec=1min
OnUnitActiveSec=5min
AccuracySec=30s
RandomizedDelaySec=0
Persistent=true
Unit=inventory-config-sync.service

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target
ANTRIEB_TIMER
